QUOTE: The function pointers start at `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_FREE`. If the config does not define those, they default to stubs (`platform.c:24-42`). The stub calloc returns NULL and the stub free does nothing. So a build with `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and no allocator configured fails every allocation until something sets one.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the default stubs fail (calloc returns NULL, free does nothing) instead of falling back to libc.
